result.brief: 提出基于时间邻近自监督的行为轨迹表征学习框架，从短时运动轨迹中提取身份与学习进度信号，并用表征条件扩散模型检视运动模式。
result.reason: Self-supervised temporal-proximity representation learning on animal movement trajectories; representation contribution is behavioral, not visual/video, so transfer to visual world models is plausible but unverified.
